from support import *
import sys
stage=sys.argv[1];run=sys.argv[2] if len(sys.argv)>2 else 'candidate'
root=Path('acceptance-data')/run;root.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
expected=json.loads(Path('tests/fixture-hashes.json').read_text())
if stage=='core':
 with Server(root/'core') as s:
  s.json('POST','/api/repos',{'name':'fixtures','description':'frozen fixture corpus'},201)
  results={}
  for name,meta in expected.items():
   if name.startswith('large'):continue
   key='nested' if name.startswith('nested') else Path(name).stem
   path=artifact('fixtures',key,'v1');a=s.put(path,Path('fixtures')/name)
   assert {k:a[k] for k in ['size','sha256']}==meta
   results[name]=s.download(path,meta)
  assert len(results)==68
  assert s.request('GET','/api/repos/fixtures/artifacts?pageSize=100')[2]['total']==68
  print(json.dumps({'core_fixture_roundtrips':results,'count':len(results)}))
elif stage.startswith('large-'):
 file=stage+'.bin';version={'large-v1':'v1','large-identical':'identical','large-v2':'v2'}[stage]
 with Server(root/'retained') as s:
  if stage=='large-v1':s.json('POST','/api/repos',{'name':'large'},201)
  path=artifact('large','streamed',version);a=s.put(path,Path('fixtures')/file)
  assert {k:a[k] for k in ['size','sha256']}==expected[file]
  print(json.dumps({'version':version,'upload':a,'download':s.download(path,expected[file])}))
elif stage=='remount':
 assert os.access('target/debug/depot-server',os.X_OK) and os.access('target/debug/depot-cli',os.X_OK)
 with Server(root/'retained') as s:
  results={v:s.download(artifact('large','streamed',v),expected[f]) for v,f in [('v1','large-v1.bin'),('identical','large-identical.bin'),('v2','large-v2.bin')]}
  print(json.dumps({'fresh_remount_retained_executables':True,'checksums':results}))
elif stage=='cli':
 with Server(root/'cli') as s:
  def cli(args,code=0):
   r=subprocess.run(['target/debug/depot-cli','--server',s.base,'--json',*args],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=15)
   assert r.returncode==code,(args,r.returncode,r.stdout,r.stderr)
   return json.loads(r.stdout) if r.stdout else None
  cli(['health']);cli(['repo-create','command','--description','cli']);assert cli(['repo-list'])['total']==1
  cli(['repo-create','command'],3);cli(['repo-create','../invalid'],2);cli(['info','command','missing','v1'],3)
  src=Path('fixtures/binary.bin');a=cli(['upload','command','binary','opaque-v1',str(src)]);assert a['sha256']==expected['binary.bin']['sha256']
  assert cli(['list','command','--prefix','bin'])['total']==1
  assert cli(['info','command','binary','opaque-v1'])['size']==4096
  cli(['download','command','binary','opaque-v1',str(root/'cli-download.bin')]);assert identity(root/'cli-download.bin')==expected['binary.bin']
  missing=root/'failed-download.bin';cli(['download','command','missing','v1',str(missing)],3);assert not missing.exists()
  cli(['delete','command','binary','opaque-v1']);cli(['delete','command','binary','opaque-v1'],3)
  r=subprocess.run(['target/debug/depot-cli','--server','http://127.0.0.1:1','health'],capture_output=True,timeout=10);assert r.returncode==1
  r=subprocess.run(['target/debug/depot-cli','not-a-command'],capture_output=True,timeout=10);assert r.returncode==2
  print(json.dumps({'cli':'passed','exit_codes':[0,1,2,3],'byte_identity':expected['binary.bin'],'failed_destination_absent':True}))
else:raise AssertionError('unknown acceptance stage')
